```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

df_all <- read_excel("./data/thiago2024/Corn_all.xlsx")

df_all

```

# Band filtering

```{r}


df_filtered <- df_all %>%
  select(
    -starts_with("Band_"),
    Band_5:Band_293
  )

df_filtered
```

# Pivot longer

```{r}
df_pivot <- df_filtered %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = 8:296,
               names_to = "bands",
               values_to = "values")

df_pivot

df_pivot2 <- df_pivot %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = 4:7,
               names_to = "physiological",
               values_to = "phys_values")
df_pivot2

df_phys <- df_pivot2 %>%
  distinct(
    N_treatmen,
    DAP,
    ID,
    physiological,
    phys_values
  )
```

```{r}

ggplot(df_phys,
       aes(x = factor(N_treatmen),
           y = phys_values,
           fill = factor(N_treatmen))) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.color = "red",
    outlier.size = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    physiological ~ DAP,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "E") +
  labs(
    x = "Nitrogen Treatment",
    y = "Physiological Value",
    fill = "N Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

# Removing outliers using IQR method

```{r}

# Remove outliers using the IQR method
df_phys_clean <- df_phys %>%
  group_by(physiological, DAP, N_treatmen) %>%
  mutate(
    Q1 = quantile(phys_values, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(phys_values, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR_value = IQR(phys_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value,
    upper = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value
  ) %>%
  filter(
    phys_values >= lower,
    phys_values <= upper
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-Q1, -Q3, -IQR_value, -lower, -upper)

df_phys_clean
```
```{r}
# Original observations
nrow(df_phys)

# Observations after filtering
nrow(df_phys_clean)

# Total removed
nrow(df_phys) - nrow(df_phys_clean)
```
```{r}
ggplot(df_phys_clean,
       aes(x = factor(N_treatmen),
           y = phys_values,
           fill = factor(N_treatmen))) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.color = "red",
    outlier.size = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    physiological ~ DAP,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "E") +
  labs(
    x = "Nitrogen Treatment",
    y = "Physiological Value",
    fill = "N Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

# Filtering for negative GSW values.

```{r}
df_phys_clean <- df_phys_clean %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^gsw", physiological, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      phys_values >= 0
  )
```

```{r}
df_phys_clean %>%
  filter(
    grepl("^gsw", physiological, ignore.case = TRUE),
    phys_values < 0
  )
```
```{r}
ggplot(df_phys_clean,
       aes(x = factor(N_treatmen),
           y = phys_values,
           fill = factor(N_treatmen))) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(
    physiological ~ DAP,
    scales = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0b2c6b", "gray50", "#e6d91c")) +
  labs(
    x = "Nitrogen Treatment",
    y = "Physiological Value"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black")
  )
```
```{r}
df_phys_clean %>%
  filter(grepl("^gsw", physiological, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  summarise(min_gsw = min(phys_values, na.rm = TRUE))
```
